:::: case-study-section
::: section-label
ABOUT THE PROJECT
:::

<h2 class="case-study-title">

Sports stories don't stop on the field.

</h2>

<p>For this group project, we analyzed how athletes and their families are represented across online media and how those portrayals can shape the way audiences understand public figures.</p>

<p>Our research dives into the relationship between sports, celebrity culture, family representation, and digital media.</p>

<p>This project required research, media analysis, collaboration, and a presentation on our findings.</p>
